subject: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and secure evidence handoff
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Alec Byrne <alec.byrne@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and secure evidence handoff

Hi Alec,

Hope you’re well. We’re starting the vendor assurance intake for Acme and wanted to request a copy of your most recent SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) and a bridge letter if the report period end date doesn’t cover the last 12 months. For our records please include:

- SOC 2 Type II report (full PDF)
- Any bridge letter or auditor affirmation (if the report is older than the requested audit window)
- An evidence manifest or index (high-level list of artifacts/timestamps)
- Auditor contact (name + email) for any verification questions

For clarity: our target audit window is Oct 1, 2026 – Sep 30, 2027. If your report covers a different period, a short bridge letter that states continuity of controls or confirms any change-in-coverage dates will be fine.

Preferred transfer methods (pick one):
- Presigned S3 URL (recommended) — 72 hours expiry; we’ll provide presigned PUTs and folder naming guidance.
- Secure upload portal (we can send a single-use link).
- Encrypted SFTP — if you prefer SFTP we’ll provide connection details.

I’ve attached a minimal evidence manifest template to speed intake. If you’d rather we send an intake link and a short consent/transfer form to your procurement/audit team, let us know and we’ll include a pre-filled DocuSign consent form for the auditor.

Sample asks and what’s fine to redact: we only need the auditor report PDF and a bridge letter; system-level logs or PII can be redacted. The evidence manifest should map artifact names to the control families (e.g., change management, access reviews) and indicate whether artifacts are available on request.

Next step: if you confirm preferred transfer method and the right contact for procurement/audit, we’ll generate the presigned link and a consent doc for your auditor.

Thanks — looking forward to coordinating.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_evidence_manifest_template.xlsx (Excel)]

From: Alec Byrne <alec.byrne@acme.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Sally Thomas <sally.thomas@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and secure evidence handoff

Evelyn —

Thanks for the clear note. We can provide the Type II report and bridge letter. A few quick items from our side:

- Procurement will need a brief note stating the purpose and the recipient (Redwood). Do you have a one-paragraph statement we can forward internally?
- Our auditor prefers a signed consent to share the report (auditor permission). Can you send a template consent/authorization they can sign?
- Presigned S3 works for us; please confirm expected expiry and whether we should encrypt the file before upload.

Attached is our vendor security questionnaire — Procurement asked we return that alongside the report.

Alec Byrne
Sr. Security Operations Manager
Acme Corp
[Attachment: acme_vendor_questionnaire.docx (Word)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alec Byrne <alec.byrne@acme.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and secure evidence handoff

Hi Alec — thanks, we can take this forward. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) Purpose statement for procurement (copy/paste):
"Redwood Inference requests a copy of Acme Corp's SOC 2 Type II report and any applicable bridge letter for the purpose of vendor assurance and compliance review. The report will be used solely by Redwood's security and procurement teams to validate control coverage and will be retained in accordance with Redwood's data retention policy."

2) Auditor consent template: attached ("consent_to_share.docx"). The template authorizes your auditor to provide the report to Redwood for vendor assurance. We typically ask the auditor to initial the page where they confirm issuance and coverage dates.

3) Transfer preferences and guidance:
- Presigned S3 (recommended): we’ll issue a presigned PUT that expires in 72 hours. Please encrypt at rest if you store the file locally; in-transit to presigned URL is TLS protected. Use folder name: acme_socs/2027_typeii/ and filename: acme_soc2_typeii_2027.pdf.
- Secure portal: single-use upload link valid 7 days (we can send if presigned is not possible).
- SFTP: provide host, username and key; we’ll generate an account.

4) Minimal manifest guidance (we attached the manifest template you received). Please map high-level artifacts (policy snapshots, change request samples, access-review logs) to control areas and mark items that require auditor follow-up. Redactions are acceptable if marked in the manifest.

5) Suggested copy for auditor email (to speed consent):
"Dear [Auditor], Acme Corp authorizes [Auditor Name] to provide Acme Corp's SOC 2 Type II report (covering the audit period indicated) to Redwood Inference for vendor assurance. Please sign the attached consent form and confirm issuance/coverage dates."

Attachments included: consent_to_share.docx, redwood_evidence_manifest_template.xlsx

Suggested one-line replies you can send back to procurement or your auditor:
- "We will upload the SOC 2 Type II report to the presigned S3 link within 48 hours."
- "Auditor has been asked to sign the attached consent form; we’ll share the signed copy once received."
- "We will redact PII from the evidence artifacts and indicate redactions in the manifest."

Let us know which transfer option you prefer and we’ll create the presigned link and a pre-filled DocuSign for the auditor.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Security Operations (Vendor Intake)
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: consent_to_share.docx (Word)]

From: Alec Byrne <alec.byrne@acme.com>

Monica — thanks for the templates and the procurement blurb. We’ll proceed with: presigned S3 (72-hr expiry) and the auditor consent flow. Expect the upload within 48 hours; procurement will also return the completed vendor questionnaire you attached.

I’ll follow up with the signed consent from our auditor once it’s returned.

Best,
Alec Byrne
Sr. Security Operations Manager
Acme Corp
